question: dame la comisión efectiva en porcentaje de cada nivel de riesgo de comercio, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql: SELECT m.risk_tier, 100.0 * SUM(s.fee_eur_minor) / SUM(s.gross_eur_minor) AS mdr_efectivo FROM fact_settlement_batch s JOIN dim_merchant m ON s.merchant_id = m.merchant_id GROUP BY m.risk_tier ORDER BY mdr_efectivo DESC
